curation.notes: Imported from validation panel. Original serotype: Poona. Panel notes: Detected a genetic marker (galE allele) for ancillary O22.

reads.download_cmd: fasterq-dump --gzip --outdir data/ SRR2533587 && mv data/SRR2533587_1.fastq.gz data/reads_1.fq.gz && mv data/SRR2533587_2.fastq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz

SeqSero2.run_cmd: SeqSero2_package.py -m a -t 4 -i data/reads_1.fq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz -d actual/seqsero2/ -n seqsero2

SeqSero2S.run_cmd: SeqSero2S_package.py -m a -t 4 -i data/reads_1.fq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz -d actual/seqsero2s/ -n seqsero2s

validation_instructions.serological: Expected serotype: Poona. Antigenic formula should match 13:z:1,6. Note: Ancillary O22 antigen marker (galE allele) may be detected.
validation_instructions.mlst: Expected ST447. Accept exact match. Flag novel alleles for manual review.

notes: Part of FDA-CFSAN validation panel. Detected a genetic marker (galE allele) for ancillary O22.
